12 · Demonstrate disagreement and recovery.

Devnet experimentObserved outcome
One extreme producer cannot move the medianInjected 999,999 bps into one Marginfi producer. Three signed reports finalized to 700 bps, the median of the reports.
Losing one consumer prevents publicationWith consumer-3 stopped, a round collected two votes and closed with no quorum. AllocationState retained an earlier published round.
Restart recovers from on-chain round stateThe restarted consumer resumed with its existing wallet, read the active snapshot, and restored a three-signature publication with no duplicate operator votes.
Stale inputs do not force an invalid allocationAfter all Marginfi producers stopped, its feed exceeded the configured freshness limit. Save and Kamino share a 75% category cap, so every consumer abstained. The round closed and the previous allocation was retained.
The full pipeline resumes after feed recoveryAll producers resumed from persistent state, refreshed the independent feeds, and three consumers published a valid allocation with all inputs eligible.

Five experiments passed. Their public signatures and account snapshots are displayed in the Resilience tab ↗.
